designSummary: Weekly group run chart of the HPCIA share with the baseline median as centre line, a p-chart as a secondary display, and monthly per-clinic charts for feedback.
sampleSize: The group writes about 90 systemic antimicrobial prescriptions a week, so a weekly group point rests on about 90 prescriptions. With a baseline near 27 percent, a p-chart with subgroups of 90 has 3-sigma limits about 14 percentage points either side of the centre line; weekly points per clinic (about 22 prescriptions) would have limits near 28 points, too wide for feedback, so clinic feedback uses monthly points (about 95 prescriptions each). A fall to 15 percent held for six consecutive weeks triggers the shift rule, which is the smallest change the partners consider worth keeping; 12 baseline and 16 intervention points allow it to trigger during cycle 2 or 3.
primaryAnalysis: Run chart of the weekly group HPCIA share judged by pre-specified rules: a shift of six or more consecutive points below the baseline median, a trend of five or more consecutive decreases, too few runs, or an astronomical point agreed by the team. The median is frozen after baseline and recalculated only after a sustained shift.
secondaryAnalysis: p-chart of the same data; run charts of the amoxicillin-clavulanate share and prompt reasons; monthly charts of culture before treatment, 7-day re-consultation and owner complaints; monthly per-clinic HPCIA charts for feedback only.
missingData: Weeks with a report failure are re-run the same day; if a week cannot be extracted it is left as a gap on the chart and annotated, never imputed.
multiplicity: One outcome measure carries the aim; process and balancing measures are descriptive and are not tested for significance.
software: Spreadsheet run chart template kept by the practice manager; charts checked by the clinical director.
overfittingGuards: Run chart rules and HPCIA product list fixed before the baseline is extracted
Baseline median frozen until a sustained shift
Cycle changes marked on the chart before later points are examined
summary: Weekly group run chart with pre-specified rules; about 90 prescriptions per point; clinic feedback monthly because weekly clinic points are too noisy.
